# EHS Simplified
> Full-scale EHS consulting for small manufacturers (under 100 employees), delivered fractionally. A Certified Safety Professional (CSP) pairs 25+ years of experience with a mobile safety platform. Plans start at $129/month.

EHS Simplified is a CSP-led EHS consulting practice built for small and midsize manufacturers — metal fabrication, machining, assembly, and food & beverage production — who carry full OSHA compliance obligations without an in-house safety department. It combines a dedicated fractional EHS Manager with a mobile app covering safety inspections, SDS library management, hazard and near-miss reporting, OSHA-aligned training, and incident investigation. EHS Simplified also supports retail/warehousing, hospitality/food service, and cannabis operations.

## What EHS Simplified Does
- Dedicated fractional EHS Manager time, scaled by plan
- Mobile app for workplace safety management (inspections, checklists, hazard reporting)
- SDS (Safety Data Sheet) library, built and maintained
- OSHA-aligned safety training, including new-hire onboarding
- OSHA 300/300A/301 recordkeeping support
- Incident investigation and risk assessments
- Quarterly and annual compliance audits (plan-dependent)

## Who It's For
Small and midsize manufacturers, generally under 100 employees:
- Metal fabrication and machining
- Assembly operations
- Food and beverage production
Also supported: retail & warehousing, hospitality & food service, cannabis operations.

## Pricing (plans start at $129/month, 12-month agreement)
- Safety Standby — $129/mo: full app access, quarterly EHS Manager check-in
- Safety Guided — $249/mo: monthly check-in, 1 safety program/month
- Safety Partnered — $429/mo (most popular): 2 hrs/month EHS Manager time, 2 safety programs/month, OSHA 300 log management
- Safety Embedded — $849/mo: 4+ hrs/month, dedicated EHS Manager, full OSHA recordkeeping
- Safety Executive — $1,499/mo: 8+ hrs/month, quarterly on-site visit, annual mock OSHA audit
